name: HospitalSetting
description: Stores configurable hospital-wide settings such as operating hours, holidays, and general policies.

attributes.name: settingName
attributes.description: The unique name of the hospital setting.

attributes.name: settingValue
attributes.description: The value of the hospital setting, potentially in JSON format for complex settings.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: A description of what the setting controls.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: The category of the hospital setting (e.g., 'operational', 'policy').
